methodologyNotes: Covers fixed wall-mount, handheld, and combination (dual) residential shower heads sold at a published US price. Excludes complete shower systems with valves/panels, tub spouts, bidet sprayers, and body-jet tower kits. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. flowRateGpm is the rated maximum flow in US gallons per minute at 80 PSI (US Federal cap is 2.5). sprayModes is the count of distinct published spray patterns/settings (a single fixed spray = 1). faceDiameterIn is the spray face diameter in inches (for non-round faces, the longest dimension). mountType is an enum: fixed, handheld, dual, ceiling. handheldIncluded is a boolean for whether a detachable handheld wand ships in the box. hoseLengthIn is the included hose length in inches; null if no hose ships. bodyMaterial is an enum describing the primary wetted body: brass, metal, stainless, plastic. finishOptions is the count of finish/color variants the model is sold in. connectionSizeIn is the inlet thread size in inches (US standard is 0.5 NPT). selfCleaning is a boolean for rub-clean or anti-clog silicone nozzles. warrantyYears is the manufacturer's stated warranty in years (limited-lifetime is recorded as 99); null if not disclosed.
